travelAdvisoryUS.summary:
Updated to reflect change to Travel Advisory Level 3.
Reconsider travel to New Caledonia due to civil unrest and crime.
U.S. citizens should reconsider travel to New Caledonia or consider departing by commercial or other privately available transportation options, in light of the current security situation and infrastructure challenges following riots related to electoral reform in May 2024.
